findings.finding: The script replaces alice-market.service ExecStart with a hard-coded `/usr/bin/python3 ... runtime.py --config /etc/alice-market/market-runtime.json`, but preflight checks only WorkingDirectory. It does not prove that this matches the current effective ExecStart/interpreter/arguments or that required Environment, LoadCredential and service identity settings remain valid. The drop-in preserves other settings, but replacing ExecStart can change active runtime startup semantics.
findings.recommendation: Before any write, read and pin the current effective ExecStart, User, Group, EnvironmentFiles, LoadCredential/Credentials and drop-in set; require the expected config path and preserve all existing credential/environment directives. Abort on any difference.

findings.finding: The script verifies that the new unit/drop-in files do not exist, but it does not verify that both drop-in parent directories exist, are root-owned and non-writable by group/world. It creates the group before discovering a missing parent directory, and a write failure can leave partial files not yet present in `made`, complicating rollback.
findings.recommendation: Preflight the exact parent directories for alice-market.service.d and alisa-platform@stage.service.d before group creation; require trusted ownership/mode. Create/record each new file atomically and enroll its path in recovery before writing bytes.
